llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam indicators: claims of SEC licensing and global operational history despite the domain being created only weeks ago, domain registration details do not match stated US headquarters (registrant is Germany), exaggerated promotional language, no outbound or verification links, psychological triggers (zero fees, massive speed, guaranteed safety), inappropriate business contact (personalized non-corporate email), and vague privacy and payment details. These align with several listed scam website characteristics, most notably those for cryptocurrency scams.
